correctness.rationale: Np(rho)=(1-p)rho+(p/3)(XrhoX+YrhoY+ZrhoZ) has Bloch contraction alpha=1-4p/3, hence Np(UrhoUdagger)=U Np(rho) Udagger for every unitary. Isotropic semigroup channels commute with all pulse conjugations, so any finite interleaved sequence equals overall pulse-frame rotation composed with the unchanged total-time depolarization. Original Appendix average is Np of the input Pauli twirl (I/2 for balanced I,X,Y,Z); in the frame-corrected version every term is just Np(rho). Printed p exp(-gamma/f) tends to p, not 0. This is an exact analytic proof, scoped to the specified memoryless isotropic channel and ideal unitary pulses, not microscopic colored baths.
